name: STAR Telemetry — AOS/TM frame check in C (embedded-oriented)
summary: CCSDS AOS v2 / TM v1 primary header decode and FECF CRC-16 check in C99, verified identical on 18 emulated ISAs and 12 simulated MCUs / space processors, cross-checked with spacepackets, fuzzed and mutation-tested.
reference: CCSDS 732.0-B (AOS) and 132.0-B (TM) frame layouts; CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE check value 0x29B1; NASA JPL F Prime native AOS frames
reference_observed: 5 F Prime native frames + 300 bit-flipped equal to the Python reference on 30 targets; spacepackets agreement 40/40 + 260/260

na.G-09: no simulation component of its own (runs ON simulators)
na.G-10: not flight software (no flight heritage claimed)
na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-02: src/star_aos.h (API), src/star_aos.c (core), src/host_main.c (host driver), fw/ (per-target startup and UART)
review.G-04: octets in, header fields out; no units
review.G-06: no third-party code; F Prime frames used as test data with provenance in star_telemetry
review.G-08: no I/O in the core; host_main reads a file given on the command line
review.G-13: R4: NULL and short inputs return error codes; fuzzing with ASan/UBSan finds no out-of-bounds read
